title: Nova bot for new duties integration

title: zbmaus
content: The user's OpenMausBot ecosystem is named 'zbmaus'. It consists of bots, routines/triggers, rooms, memory, skills, connected apps, and data tools running on a VPS (maus.abstract.biz.id). The user's GitHub account is Niumination with ~150 repos, many of which relate to this ecosystem (omb-lightvela, ecosystem-omb, ecosystem-config, brain, mirai, hermes-agent, etc.).
